author: ai
text: BRICS had 4 members at its founding in 2009: Brazil, Russia, India and China. South Africa joined in 2011. Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia joined in 2024, and Indonesia joined in 2025. BRICS lists Saudi Arabia as a member, but Saudi Arabia has not confirmed it. The facts record no departures or suspensions. With Saudi Arabia counted, BRICS had 11 members in 2026.
